claims.value: CBP Advanced Training Center Mezzanine Expansion

conflict_flags.rationale: BOD and SOW both use 'Mezzanine Expansion' framing. 'Tactical Training Renovation' is the electrical subcontractor's job name, which may be a broader or simplified designation. BOD/SOW are design-team and owner documents; treated as authoritative for project name.

The Architectural section calls it 'building 6' which aligns with the SOW's 'Tactical Training Building' reference; the Mechanical section uses 'Building 131' which may be an alternate building number designation (e.g., federal real property number vs. local number). Both may be correct but refer to the same building under different numbering schemes. Flagged for human review.
